evidenceNotes: Lifetime goal: 250,000 overall reported video views by December 31 Eastern. Known total 148,405; historical coverage is not campaign growth.

93 public measured records plus seven private/unlisted YouTube records in aggregate: 100 measured posts. Focused updates cover four YouTube Shorts and five TikTok posts. Newer Instagram counters remain unknown; X is excluded from headline totals. Other inventory dates remain unchanged.
Focused owner-inventory observations at 23:06-23:09 UTC on October 11 updated nine public posts. Full inventory observations remain dated around 19:49-19:52 UTC; component times stay separate.

Focused YouTube and TikTok updates changed the prior saved campaign total by +1,833. Other counters retain their earlier dates. This is a partial campaign total, with no full inventory refresh, unique-audience or distribution-attribution claim.

The fixed opening baseline is 14,895 YouTube Shorts views and 13,337 Instagram Reel views, measured at 2:51-2:53 AM Eastern. The 23-minute start-to-baseline gap remains unmeasured. Negative native corrections are retained.

Anubis is verified public on YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, X and Ko-fi. Lab File 003 is public on YouTube. The common planned release was 12:05 PM Eastern; native precision and processing vary. Ko-fi shows only a date, so its exact publication time is unknown.
Ko-fi Anubis remains a historical publication record; no additional Ko-fi posts are scheduled. Planned times are not actual publication times.

Owned Twitch, FACEIT and OBS source indexing remains incomplete. Editing approval used documented sampled visual and technical audio checks; unavailable listening or continuous playback is not claimed. Local operations require this PC online with Codex open.

Current campaign allocation is reconciled: 17 native-confirmed occupied posts and no future queued reservations. Three retired public experiments remain in historical records. The four Door promos are published; Next Corner posts remain drafts. New scheduling is paused because capacity is full.

All four launch teasers have native identities. X was published at 20:45:48 UTC; YouTube at 20:48:45 UTC. TikTok shows the 20:48 UTC creation minute with Everyone visibility; precise delivery time is unmeasured. Instagram exact publication time is unknown. YouTube and TikTok teaser counters are included with their separate October 11 23:06-23:09 UTC observations; Instagram remains unknown and X is excluded.

Five due four-hour reviews completed, all inconclusive. Anubis and episode retain 24/72/168-hour checks. Knife has new publication-based review jobs; actual times differ slightly across platforms. Ko-fi exact publication time remains unavailable and has a separate observation review.

Instagram followers remain the dated 73 observation. Retention and engagement findings are shown in the review log with their own timestamps. Unknown counters are not zero; X views remain outside headline growth.

Door publication verified October 11: YouTube at 22:00:50 UTC, X at 22:00:52 UTC, Instagram at 22:01:04 UTC. TikTok shows the 22:00 UTC native creation minute with Everyone visibility; exact public-delivery instant is unmeasured. YouTube and TikTok Door counters were subsequently observed at 23:06-23:09 UTC; Instagram remains unknown and X is excluded.
